name: hospital_decal_girls
_orig: Zone 1 のトンネル（8 枚）。本家「GIRLS, GIRLS, GIRLS!」
prompt: Big, aggressive drippy spray-paint lettering across the wall, with a crude doodle of a hand pointing straight at the viewer beside it.

name: hospital_decal_healyou
_orig: Zone 1 のトンネル（4 枚）。本家「LET US HEAL YOU」
prompt: Cheerful but creepy hand lettering in two lines, like a friendly greeting written by someone unhinged, with a small doodle of Wasami's grinning face.

name: hospital_decal_mercy
_orig: Zone 1 のトンネル（5 枚）。本家「ACCEPT OUR MERCY」
prompt: Thin, shaky, hand-written lettering in two lines, as if scrawled in a hurry by a trembling hand.

name: hospital_decal_yourstory
_orig: Zone 1 のトンネル（12 枚）。本家「YOUR STORY ENDS HERE」
prompt: Ominous hand lettering in two lines with long paint drips running down from the letters, like a final warning.

name: hospital_decal_graffiti_02
_orig: Zone 2（4 枚）。本家「Men Are Stupid & Weak」
prompt: Stacked graffiti lettering filling the square, needy and obsessive in tone.

name: hospital_decal_graffiti_03
prompt: Heavy, dripping block lettering stacked in the square, with a simple doodle of a single wide-open staring eye.

name: hospital_decal_graffiti_04
_orig: Zone 2（15 枚。いちばん多い）。本家「LIAR LIAR」
prompt: The same short shout written twice, stacked, in big jagged spray-paint letters that fill the square.

name: hospital_decal_graffiti_05
_orig: Zone 2（2 枚）。本家「LOVE IS ONLY SKIN DEEP」
prompt: Rounded bubble-style graffiti lettering in stacked lines, sweet-looking letters with an unsettling meaning.

name: hospital_decal_graffiti_06
prompt: Wide, heavy graffiti lettering in two lines, like a question shouted into an empty building.

name: hospital_decal_graffiti_07
prompt: Fast, slanted lettering with speed lines, as if written while running.

name: hospital_decal_graffiti_08
prompt: Big, over-enthusiastic lettering in two lines with a doodle of a thumbs-up drawn in a creepy way (too many knuckles).

name: hospital_decal_lovesmenot
_orig: Zone 2（2 枚。Graffiti_09）。本家「HE LOVES ME, HE LOVES ME NOT」
prompt: The same name written over and over in two lines, obsessively, in scratchy hand lettering.
text: ワサミ ワサミ ワサミ ワサミ

name: hospital_decal_mediocreman
prompt: Lazy, shrugging hand lettering, slightly crooked, with a tiny doodle of a shrugging stick figure.

name: hospital_decal_nohappily
_orig: Zone 2（3 枚。Graffiti_11）。本家「NO HAPPILY EVER AFTERS」
prompt: Sarcastic lettering in two lines, with long drips hanging from the letters.

name: hospital_decal_prettyface
_orig: Zone 2 の秘密の部屋の外（1 枚。Graffiti_12）。本家「JUST ANOTHER PRETTY FACE」
prompt: A crude spray-paint line drawing of Wasami's face with huge staring eyes and a wide open mouth, next to a short call in hand lettering.

name: hospital_decal_virus
prompt: Bold lettering followed by a doodle of a virus particle whose round body is Wasami's face, spikes all around it.

name: hospital_decal_mysteryroom_01
_orig: Zone 2 の秘密の部屋（1 枚）。本家は薬のカプセルの落書き（字なし）
prompt: Scattered doodles with no text: round soft rice-cake mochi with little Wasami faces on them, and a few pill capsules, drawn as white line art spread across the whole wide canvas.

name: hospital_decal_mysteryroom_02
_orig: Zone 2 の秘密の部屋（1 枚）。本家「SHE WAS CRAZY」
prompt: Unsettling hand lettering in two lines, like a secret confession scratched onto the wall of a hidden room.
text: ワサミはどこにでもいる
